
{{alias}}( x, y )
    Tests if two values have the same constructor.

    Parameters
    ----------
    a: any
        First input value.

    b: any
        Second input value.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating whether two values have same constructor.

    Examples
    --------
    > var bool = {{alias}}( new Date(), new Date() );
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( new Date(), 'Hello');
    false
    > bool = {{alias}}(new String('Hello'), 'World');
    true

    See Also
    --------
